pm-vcs.release: An approved package publication from a verified main revision.
pm-vcs.gate: A fail-closed check before accepting a VCS operation.
pm-vcs.lease: A writer's fenced authority to publish shared repository state.
pm-vcs.receipt: A retained record of a verified VCS operation and its identity.
pm-vcs.record: A structured versioned unit with stable identity.
pm-vcs.revision: An immutable version of a structured record.
pm-vcs.branch: A named line of repository changes.
pm-vcs.merge: A three-way reconciliation of independent versions.
pm-vcs.index: The staged view prepared for a repository change.
pm-vcs.bundle: A bounded transport of selected repository objects and permissions.
pm-vcs.commit: A recorded repository change with attributable content.
pm-vcs.ref: A name that points to a repository object.
pm-vcs.history: The attributable sequence of repository operations.

pm-rl.release: An approved publication of the learning-management package.
pm-rl.gate: A declared evidence condition before promoting a candidate.
pm-rl.receipt: Retained evidence of a learning operation and outcome.
pm-rl.benchmark: A content-addressed evaluation suite with fixed identity.
pm-rl.run: An attributable execution of a learning recipe.
pm-rl.evaluation: A measured candidate outcome against a named suite.
pm-rl.generation: A persisted candidate in a recursive improvement lineage.
pm-rl.checkpoint: A pinned candidate or model state used for evaluation.
pm-rl.policy: The candidate decision behavior being evaluated.
pm-rl.promotion: A guarded adoption of a candidate after declared evidence.
pm-rl.lineage: The recorded ancestry between learning generations.
pm-rl.sample: An observation contributing to a measured evaluation.

pm-evidence.receipt: An explicit record of source verification or omission.
pm-evidence.source: An authorized external or native context input.
pm-evidence.fragment: An exactly selected region of source content.
pm-evidence.citation: A retained reference to an exact source fragment.
pm-evidence.freshness: Whether a selected fragment still matches its retained content.
pm-evidence.replay: Reading an explicitly retained historical source fragment.
pm-evidence.binding: A relationship between a criterion and its exact revision evidence.
pm-evidence.scope: The explicitly authorized boundary of a source selection.
pm-evidence.contract: The declared source-reader or selector behavior.
pm-evidence.selector: A bounded rule identifying an exact source fragment.
pm-evidence.consent: An explicit authorization for retention or transfer.
pm-evidence.descriptor: The structured declaration of a source and selection.
pm-evidence.provenance: The recorded origin and revision of selected evidence.
pm-evidence.artifact: An explicitly retained representation of authorized evidence.
